subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about reactivating dormant payers for your mid-core and RPG titles. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the validated paid IAP from a re-engaged lapsed payer, read server-side through MMP re-engagement attribution with Google Play receipt validation, so you pay for a returning spender rather than a re-open. At that bar we recover around 4,000 payer conversions a day from dormant payers. If useful, I can share the spend-tier recovery view for your lapsed cohorts. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate payer-conversion proof (validated IAP + server-side re-engagement attribution)
illustrative_flags: 4,000 payer conversions a day recovered from dormant payers (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN gaming_midcore_hardcore retargeting: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (validated paid IAP optimization + server-side re-engagement attribution with Google Play receipt validation); one illustrative MobUpps figure (4,000 payer conversions/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; native US peer register; no X-not-Y (positive stated with 'rather than').
